authorization.objective: Test whether production-style precompiled ORT QNN EPContext/context binaries reduce cold setup versus source-ONNX QNN compilation for the accepted all-HTP stable-Softplus Supertonic route.

lineage.baseline_claim_boundary: Source assets are official FP32 ONNX; QNN HTP internal lowering precision is not established and must not be called FP32 arithmetic. Pre/postprocessing, orchestration, trimming and WAV encoding are CPU work.
lineage.baseline_numerical_warning: The historical HTP-vs-CPU whole-waveform cosine was 0.92668 and failed its frozen 0.95 numerical policy despite Moritz accepting that exact historical HTP WAV. That verdict cannot transfer to 0022.

graphs.identity_rule: Arms A and B must consume the same four graph identities. Do not silently regenerate shape-specialized graphs with different hashes.

matched_arms.A_source_onnx: Fresh process creates duration, text, stable-Softplus vector and vocoder QNN sessions from frozen ONNX; compilation is inside measured readiness/setup.
matched_arms.B_precompiled_context: Fresh process creates the same sessions only from reload-gated external EPContext descriptors/binaries; offline context generation is separately reported and excluded from arm-B startup.
matched_arms.only_intended_variable: source ONNX QNN compilation versus precompiled context reload

required_gates: canonical frontend and fixed-shape compatibility frozen before output
host source assignment for all four graphs with fallback disabled
context generation with per-session and total wall time, tool identity, hashes and sizes
independent fresh-process EPContext reload with source ONNX unavailable
physical QNN provider plus RPC, accelerator time, accelerator cycles and HVX thread evidence
three or more independent cold processes per arm
one first plus five same-session warm complete generations in each measured process
full generation-state reset before each generation
PSS, VmHWM, thermal and power evidence
fresh exact-hash listening verdict if bytes differ
claim_boundaries: No startup reduction claim until both arms pass the same assignment, reload and physical-proof gates.
Context-generation time is an offline production cost and is never hidden; it is not part of arm-B cold startup.
Host QNN assignment or reload is not physical phone HTP proof.
An EPContext descriptor loading successfully is not proof that accelerator execution occurred.
No FP32-arithmetic claim is permitted for QNN HTP internal lowering.
The 0011 and 0021 performance or listening verdicts do not transfer to 0022.
Any byte-different WAV begins not_reviewed and only Moritz may accept or reject that exact hash.
No historical record or dashboard source may be overwritten.

current_blocker_or_design_gate.fact: The exact frozen 0011 graphs require processed T239/L238, but canonical-v2 text wrapped as <en>...</en> is length 235.
current_blocker_or_design_gate.investigation: Four right-side positions used filler ID 0 and mask 0.0; seven filler IDs produced byte-identical outputs, proving payload masking, but the T239 sequence extent materially changed the dynamic-T235 canonical result.
current_blocker_or_design_gate.required_action: Stop before runner implementation, EPContext generation, output generation, or phone access.
current_blocker_or_design_gate.forbidden_shortcut: Do not substitute the 230-byte legacy transcript, silently alter canonical bytes, regenerate differently hashed graphs and call them the same route, or label the masked T239 calculation exact canonical-v2 semantics.
